import csv
cool="5b98cbc1-fd25-5d8c-a96e-c3de49819174"
heat="b7f22e0c-833d-5373-87e1-51e1cb26f038"
temp="e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8"
data={cool:[],heat:[],temp:[]}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["timeseries_id"] in data:
            data[row["timeseries_id"]].append((row["timestamp"],float(row["value"])))
for k in data:
    print(k,len(data[k]))
# filter date
date="2018-04-12"
def sel(k):
    d=[(" ".join(t.split()[0:1]),v) for t,v in data[k] if t.startswith(date)]
    return dict(d)
c=sel(cool); h=sel(heat); t=sel(temp)
print(len(c),len(h),len(t))
count=0
details=[]
for ts in t:
    tv=t[ts]; cv=c.get(ts); hv=h.get(ts)
    out = (hv is not None and tv < hv) or (cv is not None and tv > cv)
    if out: count+=1
    details.append((ts,tv,hv,cv,out))
for d in details: print(d)
print("OUT_OF_BAND:",count)
